protocol.controls: Real NativeRenderer.render + wait, frozen expression renderer vs final user-source renderer. Six alternating-order serial trials, 16 warmup + 80 timed each. Three alternating-order trials, 16 warmup + 80 timed each. Baseline draws only the same background. Compilation and readback excluded. No blur.
protocol.controls_long_warmup: Real NativeRenderer.render + wait. Current committed baseline 7e53dfd0587c31b0967c1341362d0fdf08bb9b2b vs final native user-source renderer. Six alternating-order serial trials, 500 warmup + 500 timed frames each, 3000 measurements per variant/case. Compilation and readback excluded; no other GPU work or compilation concurrently. Alternate variant order every frame, always wait before next render. Three serial trials; 500 warmup + 1000 timed frames per variant/trial. No compilation or concurrent GPU work. Pixel equality asserted.
